dict.string: my-domain uses Bluetooth to reach your phone when there is no network between them, and to take your phone's calls on this Mac when you turn that on.
my-domain sends your voice to your phone during a call you take on this Mac.
my-domain shows your other devices what Spotify or Music is playing.
my-domain tells your own phone where this computer is, when you allow it in Settings.
